Event Overview

AI Insights from Industry Leaders was presented as part of an industry speaker series at Clark College. The event invited professionals from T-Mobile and Microsoft to share perspectives on two important areas of artificial intelligence: agentic AI and machine learning. The event flyer advertised a live Q&A and identified the session as free and open to all.

The program connected AI course topics with practitioner perspectives and provided a setting for discussing emerging technologies and industry applications.

Presentation Topics and Illustrative Content

1. Agentic AI: From Chatbots to Autonomous Agents

Eshaan Jain's presentation introduced the transition from chatbot-style systems toward autonomous AI agents. Supplied slides include an industry use case involving Azure Logic Apps and agentic AI for supply-chain demand forecasting, showing data ingestion, orchestration, agentic systems, and downstream business actions.

2. The AI Ladder: Stepping Stones to Generative and Agentic Systems

Dr. Kundan Karma's session materials show a presentation addressing the development of AI capabilities toward generative and agentic systems. This complements the broader discussion of contemporary machine learning and applied AI.

Documentation note: These topic descriptions are based on the event flyer and screenshots supplied for this record; they are not a transcript or a claim that every slide or demonstration has been preserved.
